content.comment_body: Hello all, I have set up four [product_name] devices at two separate sites (each site has its own router and public IP address). I've configured port forwarding for each local IP on port 8080, mapping them to individual public ports as follows: Device 1, Site 1: Local IP 10.10.10.1 on port 8080 forwarded to public port 10001, accessed via [url]:10001 Device 2, Site 1: Local IP 10.10.10.1 on port 8080 forwarded to public port 10002, accessed via [url]:10002 Device 3, Site 2: Local IP 10.10.10.11 on port 8080 forwarded to public port 10011, accessed via [url]:10011 Device 4, Site 2: Local IP 10.10.10.12 on port 8080 forwarded to public port 10012, accessed via [url]:10012 All devices are reachable using their respective web interfaces via the configured ports and addresses. However, with the [product_name] app, even though it appears possible to specify multiple device IPs and ports, I face significant issues: When setting the port for any device, the app seems to overwrite the port for all previously configured devices with the most recently entered port. For example, if I configure the last device with port 10012, all others are also set to 10012. Additionally, when I restart the app, every device's port resets back to 8080. Has anyone run into a similar situation? Is there a way to reliably set up multiple [product_name] devices in the app so each keeps its own unique port configuration? Thanks for your help, and apologies for the lengthy message.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face persistent difficulties managing multiple [product_name] devices with the [product_name] app, particularly in assigning and maintaining distinct port configurations for each device. The application fails to retain individual port settings, causing confusion and preventing effective multi-device remote control.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the ability to assign and reliably preserve unique IP and port configurations for each [product_name] device within the app, with these settings remaining intact across app restarts.
